clue.text: Twelfth Night or As You Like It?

definitions.meaning: Shakespeare's comedy carries a full title with a second part after 'or', and this is that subtitle
whatever suits you, as you please

explanation.definitionFit: The subtitle of Shakespeare's Twelfth Night is this phrase, which also means whatever pleases you, a fit for the other comedy's title.

clue.text: Time to do a hand's turn

definitions.text: Time to do a hand's turn

parts.words: Time to do a hand's turn
parts.note: a 'hand's turn' sounds like a little work, but it is the long hand of a clock going once round its face

explanation.surface: How long does it take to do a little job of work?
explanation.definitionFit: The minute hand of a clock makes one full circuit in sixty minutes.

clue.text: He opposed Stalin and survived to write about it

indicators.note: to write one word about another is to set it round that word, so the letters of to go either side of it

explanation.surface: A dissident who defied Stalin lived long enough to pen his memoirs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'write about' looks like authorship but means wrapping: T and O placed round IT.
explanation.definitionFit: The Yugoslav leader broke with Stalin in 1948 and outlived him by decades.

clue.text: It's the easiest dance to learn?

definitions.text: It's the easiest dance to learn?

parts.words: It's the easiest dance to learn?
parts.note: a dance with only a single movement to master would surely be the simplest of all

explanation.surface: Which ballroom dance is the simplest for a beginner?
explanation.definitionFit: A ragtime-era ballroom dance whose name suggests just a single movement to master.

clue.text: Cry, having very little money

parts.note: wee is Scots for small or tiny
p is short for penny or pence, British money

explanation.surface: Someone sobs because they are almost broke.
explanation.definitionFit: To shed tears is to sob, so a synonym for cry.

clue.text: Gamble a great deal on a recycled tyre

parts.note: a lot is a large amount

indicators.note: something recycled is made into something new, so the word tyre is rearranged

explanation.surface: Betting a fortune on a remoulded car tyre.
explanation.definitionFit: A raffle or draw is a game of chance, a gamble on luck.

clue.text: Man, we can't wait!

parts.note: the proverb says two forces of nature wait for no man; here they speak to him

explanation.surface: Impatient friends hurry someone along.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb holds that the clock and the sea's ebb and flow wait for nobody.

clue.text: Quite satisfied with what spring holds?

definitions.meaning: a spring is a water source, and what it contains is its contents

explanation.definitionFit: An archaic phrase for thoroughly pleased, and also the contents of a water source.

clue.text: A sneer ? I beg to differ

indicators.note: letters that differ from their first order are rearranged, so I beg is shuffled

explanation.surface: Someone politely disagrees with a sneering remark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I beg to differ' reads as a polite phrase, but 'to differ' rearranges IBEG; A is then kept as a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A taunt or jeer is a mocking remark, a sneer.

clue.text: Simply goes AWOL, gets condign punishment

parts.note: just means merely or simply
a soldier absent without leave deserts

explanation.surface: A soldier who simply walks out of the army gets what he deserves.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting what one deserves is fitting, condign punishment.

clue.text: He will shortly create uproar

indicators.note: said briefly, the auxiliary verb will is contracted to just its final two letters

parts.note: the auxiliary verb will, contracted to 'll

explanation.surface: He is about to cause a commotion.
explanation.walkthrough: HE plus 'LL, the shortened will, gives the contraction he'll.
explanation.definitionFit: A scene of chaos or noise is a pandemonium, an uproar.

clue.text: Mean to be ready to fight

definitions.meaning: with fists clenched hard, prepared to box

explanation.definitionFit: The word means stingy, and literally describes clenched fists ready for a fight.

clue.text: A case of mixed dates

parts.note: it looks like a box of assorted fruit, but means something placed in the wrong period of time

explanation.surface: A box of assorted dried fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Something placed in a period where it does not belong muddles chronology, mixing up dates.

clue.text: Fires badly singe it

indicators.note: something done badly is botched, so singe it is rearranged

explanation.surface: Flames carelessly scorch something.
explanation.definitionFit: To set alight is to kindle, the verb fires.

clue.text: Stories that may be read, anyway

indicators.note: the word can be read in either direction and stays the same

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Tales that can be read whatever happens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'anyway' is not 'in any case' but 'in any direction': the answer reads the same both ways.
explanation.definitionFit: Long Norse or family tales are epics, stories.

clue.text: Rosalind's lover is in Florida

definitions.meaning: in As You Like It, Rosalind loves the young nobleman of this name
a city in central Florida, home of theme parks

explanation.definitionFit: The hero of As You Like It who woos Rosalind, and a Florida city.

clue.text: Different article in gold

indicators.note: the article sits inside the word for gold

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: An unusual item set in gold.
explanation.definitionFit: Something distinct or alternative is different.

clue.text: Quiet Bohemian celebration?

parts.note: p is piano, the musical direction for quiet
arty describes an artistic, unconventional, Bohemian manner

explanation.surface: A subdued gathering of artistic types.
explanation.definitionFit: A social gathering to celebrate is a do, a celebration.

clue.text: White wine that goes with the joint ?

definitions.meaning: a German white wine from the Rhine
the joint in an animal's hind leg

explanation.definitionFit: A Rhine white wine, and also the hind-leg joint of a horse or similar animal.

clue.text: Indication that a writer's revision is not for the better

definitions.text: Indication that a writer's revision is not for the better

parts.words: Indication that a writer's revision is not for the better
parts.note: a proofreader's mark telling the printer to ignore a correction and keep the original

explanation.surface: An editor signals that the author's change made things worse.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin for 'let it stand', it cancels an alteration and restores the original wording.

clue.text: Infant beginning to learn confused sounds

parts.note: a babe is a baby

indicators.note: takes only the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A baby starting to learn makes muddled noises.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'team' is an OCR slip for 'learn' (rn read as m), whose first letter L the wordplay needs.
explanation.definitionFit: The tower of Babel produced a confusion of tongues, so a din of noise.

clue.text: It's read with feeling

parts.note: not read expressively, but read by touching raised dots with the fingers

explanation.surface: A text recited with emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: The raised-dot script used by blind people is read by touch.

clue.text: US city has false alarm that's cut short

indicators.note: something false is not genuine, so alarm is rearranged

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: An American town suffers a false alarm that is quickly ended.
explanation.definitionFit: A city in Wyoming, an example of a US city.

clue.text: They don't make good money

parts.note: not poorly paid workers, but people who make counterfeit money

explanation.surface: People in low-paying jobs.
explanation.definitionFit: Counterfeiters make fake banknotes and coins, which are not genuine money.

clue.text: Adam disturbed, ran out fast

indicators.note: something disturbed is thrown into disorder, so the letters of Adam and ran are mixed

explanation.surface: Upset, Adam fled outdoors quickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fast' looks like speed but is the noun, a period of abstaining.
explanation.definitionFit: The Muslim holy month is observed by fasting from dawn to dusk.

clue.text: Transmit radio broadcast of quarter-final

parts.note: S is south, a compass quarter
the end is the final part

explanation.surface: A radio station airs a quarter-final match.
explanation.definitionFit: To broadcast or dispatch a signal is to send it.

clue.text: Go for a jog, taking wrong turn

indicators.note: turning the word round reads it backwards

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: A jogger takes a wrong turn on a run.
explanation.definitionFit: To run at a gentle pace is to jog.

clue.text: A girl is after one, right?

indicators.note: is placed after the letters for one and right

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A girl is chasing someone, isn't she?
explanation.definitionFit: A female name, so an example of a girl.

clue.text: In the meantime he votes against

indicators.note: the answer lies inside the words of the meantime

explanation.surface: Meanwhile, a man casts a vote in opposition.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is opposed to a proposal is a person against it.

clue.text: Extremely jolly blue colour

parts.note: ultra means beyond or extremely
a Jolly is old naval slang for a Royal Marine

explanation.surface: A very cheerful shade of blue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jolly' is not cheerful: a Jolly is navy slang for a Royal Marine, Britain's naval infantry.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep blue pigment, once made from lapis lazuli.

clue.text: Old Irish seer is converted

indicators.note: converted means changed into another form, so seer is rearranged

explanation.surface: An ancient Irish prophet undergoes a religious conversion.
explanation.definitionFit: The Gaelic language of Ireland, an old name for Irish.

clue.text: The meteorologist's craft

parts.note: craft looks like skill or trade, but is a vessel at sea used to observe conditions

explanation.surface: The skill of forecasting.
explanation.definitionFit: A vessel stationed at sea to record atmospheric conditions for forecasts.
